nodes.name: Loan Application Process Configuration
nodes.description: Configuration for the loan application process

inputs.name: processDescription
inputs.value: Process for handling loan applications from appointment scheduling through risk assessment, credit checks, and terms acceptance.

nodes.name: Applicant Checks Appointment
nodes.description: Process starts when a potential loan applicant checks for an appointment on the company website.

nodes.name: Fill Out Loan Application
nodes.description: On the appointment date, the applicant meets the primary loan manager and fills out their application.

inputs.name: taskDescription
inputs.value: The applicant meets the primary loan manager on the appointment date and fills out the loan application ui. Review applicant details and loan amount requested.

properties.name: panelDescription
properties.value: ui for the primary loan manager to fill out the loan application details including applicant information, loan amount, and supporting documents.

nodes.name: Classify Application Risk Group
nodes.description: Check the loan amount and classify the application into one of two risk groups: Red (ineligible, including former Yellow range) or Green (auto-approved).

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Risk Group?
nodes.description: Branches based on the risk group classification: Red or Green.

nodes.name: Reject Application - Ineligible
nodes.description: The application is rejected because it falls in the Red risk group. The loan applicant receives a refusal message.

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Auto-Approve and Allocate Funds
nodes.description: The application is auto-approved as it falls in the Green risk group. Funds are allocated to the loan applicant.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to terms and conditions subprocess

nodes.name: Application Rejected (Red)
nodes.description: Process ends with the application rejected due to Red risk classification.

nodes.name: Terms and Conditions Subprocess
nodes.description: Invokes the Terms and Conditions subprocess for the Green path.

connectedTo.description: Store terms outcome for gateway evaluation

nodes.name: Store Terms Outcome (Green)
nodes.description: Reads the terms acceptance outcome set by the terms and conditions subprocess and persists it into the shared state for downstream gateway evaluation on the Green path.

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Terms Accepted? (Green)
nodes.description: Checks the outcome of the terms and conditions subprocess for the Green path.

nodes.name: Complete Application - Loan Approved (Green)
nodes.description: The application is completed and the loan is approved after terms acceptance on the Green path.

nodes.name: Deallocate Funds - Loan Rejected (Green)
nodes.description: Terms and conditions were rejected. Funds are de-allocated and the loan is rejected on the Green path.

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Loan Approved (Green)
nodes.description: Process ends successfully with the loan approved on the Green path.

nodes.name: Loan Rejected (Green)
nodes.description: Process ends with the loan rejected after terms rejection on the Green path.

nodes.name: Start Terms and Conditions Handling
nodes.description: The subprocess starts to handle the preparation and acceptance of terms and conditions.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to prepare and send terms and conditions

nodes.name: Prepare and Send Terms and Conditions
nodes.description: Terms and conditions are prepared and sent to the applicant.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to applicant review of terms and conditions

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Review and Respond to Terms and Conditions
nodes.description: The applicant reviews and responds to the terms and conditions, choosing to accept or reject them.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to store the applicant's decision

inputs.name: taskDescription
inputs.value: Please review the terms and conditions for the loan application. After reviewing, please accept or reject the terms.

properties.name: panelDescription
properties.value: This panel displays the terms and conditions document for the loan application. The applicant should review the loan amount, interest rate, repayment schedule, and all associated terms before accepting or rejecting.

nodes.name: Store Terms Decision
nodes.description: Persists the applicant's terms decision reason code into the shared state with a descriptive prefix for use by the gateway.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to check the applicant's decision

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Terms Accepted?
nodes.description: Checks whether the applicant accepted or rejected the terms and conditions.

nodes.name: End - Terms Accepted
nodes.description: The subprocess ends with a success outcome as the terms and conditions were accepted.

nodes.name: End - Terms Rejected
nodes.description: The subprocess ends with a rejection outcome as the terms and conditions were rejected.

subProcessConfig.subProcessDescription: Handles the preparation and sending of terms and conditions to the applicant, captures their acceptance or rejection decision, and routes to the appropriate outcome.

nodes.name: Credit Check 10 Day Timeout Timer
nodes.description: Triggers the event subprocess when the secondary loan manager's credit check task takes longer than 10 days.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to notify CEO after timeout

nodes.name: Send CEO Notification to Accelerate Decision
nodes.description: Sends a notification to the CEO to accelerate the decision on the loan application due to the credit check taking longer than 10 days.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to end after CEO notification is sent

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: End After CEO Notification Sent
nodes.description: The subprocess ends after the CEO notification has been sent.

subProcessConfig.subProcessDescription: Event subprocess that triggers when the secondary loan manager's credit check task takes longer than 10 days, sending a notification to the CEO to accelerate the decision on the application.

nodes.name: Credit Check 30-Day Timeout Timer
nodes.description: Triggered when the secondary loan manager's credit check task takes longer than 30 days.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to cancel the application after 30-day timeout

nodes.name: Cancel Application Due to Timeout
nodes.description: Cancels the application because the secondary loan manager did not review it within 30 days.

connectedTo.description: Send cancellation audit to external service

inputs.name: script

nodes.name: Audit Cancellation
nodes.description: Sends a PUT request to the audit service to record the application cancellation due to timeout.

connectedTo.description: Proceed to terminate the process after cancellation

inputs.name: inputScript
outputScript

nodes.name: Application Cancelled Due to Timeout
nodes.description: The subprocess ends with the application cancelled and the entire process terminated.

subProcessConfig.subProcessName: Secondary Loan Manager Credit Check Timeout Handler
subProcessConfig.subProcessDescription: Event subprocess that is triggered when the secondary loan manager's credit check task exceeds the 30-day deadline. It cancels the application and terminates the process.

nodes.name: Terminate Workflow
nodes.description: messageStartEvent

nodes.name: Event_terminate_end
nodes.description: endEvent
